<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1109
Claimant:
John Butler
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
4 Jan 2025
The claimant reported a rear-end collision at a low-speed intersection and said their neck and upper back hurt
immediately afterward. The reported injury fits the kind and force of this impact well, and the claimant is not
represented by an attorney.
5 Jan 2025
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and was covered at the time of loss.
Nothing suggests the damage occurred before the coverage period started.
19 Jan 2025
Spoke with the claimant by phone to take a recorded statement. The account of how the collision happened was
consistent with what was first reported.
3 Feb 2025
Received photos from the claimant showing rear bumper and trunk damage. The photos confirm some details of the
impact, and the vehicle damage matches the described collision.
29 Mar 2025
Requested the police report, which confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. Attempted to locate
independent witnesses, but none have come forward and no third-party accounts are available.
6 May 2025
Ran a prior claims and medical history search. No earlier injury to the neck or upper back has been found, and no
earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
8 May 2025
Authorized an independent vehicle inspection. The inspector's estimate lines up with the damage pattern shown in
the photos and with the reported point of impact.
16 May 2025
Called the claimant for a follow-up. They repeated the same account of the collision that was gievn in the first report
and the recorded statement, with no changes in the sequence of events.
17 May 2025
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury. Requested treatment records and
itemized bills from the provider to review the care plan against standard guidelines.
28 May 2025
Reviewed the file with the claims supervisor. Coverage is confirmed, the injury and vehicle damage are consistent
with the collision, and the claim will proceed to evaluation of the medical records and the length of treatment.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
